title: SimpleNotesToGDSync
description: Syncs Simplenote notes to Google Drive as Word documents. It runs SimpleNotesScraper to export the notes, converts each one from Markdown to .docx, and uploads it to a Drive folder. Only notes that changed since the last run get uploaded, and existing Drive files are updated in place rather than re-uploaded. You can organise the documents into subfolders inside the sync folder: notesync finds them there and keeps updating, renaming and deleting them where they are.
